Teaching it to differentiate between faces and look for matches in the database didn't take much time. Then I wondered, what if we ever create a mind, which will realize itself, what it will be like? In the last many years of civilization, humans kept becoming more humane. They started treating each other better, started caring for nature, animals. An opinion was formed that principles of human duty go side by side with highly developed civilization and reason. Then, shall it turn out that the mind of the computer, which of course will very quickly evolve into an over-mind due to its high learning capabilities, will also be most humane at the same time? Interesting, right? But we need to deal with these pests already. Install suppressors on the antennas you found, and, just in case, another one on the tower, also there on the Shoreline.}} ==Requirements== * Must be level 15 to start this quest. ==Objectives== * Place the first [[Signal Jammer]] on the specified place on [[Shoreline]] * Place the second [[Signal Jammer]] on the specified place on [[Shoreline]] * Place the third [[Signal Jammer]] on the specified place on [[Shoreline]] ==Rewards== * +8,500 [[EXP]] * [[Mechanic]] Rep '''+0.02''' * 30,000 Roubles ** 31,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 34,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[Benelli M3 Super 90 12ga dual-mode shotgun]] * 2× [[12/70 8.5mm Magnum buckshot ammo pack (25 pcs)]] {{quote|Great, the signal is clear.
